summary: Stewards, Inc., a Nevada short-term business credit institution, filed an 8-K reporting receipt of Nasdaq Listing Qualifications approval to list its common stock on the Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol SWRD. The company filed Form 8-A12B registering the shares under Section 12(b), OTCID quotation ceases September 9, 2026, and trading begins September 10, 2026. No concurrent public offering is involved, the CUSIP remains 312084106, and no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. This is a routine exchange listing transition, not a special situation; watch for post-listing liquidity and index eligibility.
